1. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE: Cache dependency downloads - modest benefit (free: 6%, paid: 3.4%). Preconditions: repeated dependency fetching measurable, cache inputs include lockfile and environment.

2. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST: Cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure - but contraindication: "Every matrix outcome is required". For a release binary matrix, all outcomes might be required.

3. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE: Cancel superseded runs - contraindication: "Release or deployment work". This is a release workflow, so contraindicated.

4. P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW: Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs - contraindication: "Strict contract requires all triggers to execute". Release on tags - probably all required.

5. P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER: Filter workflow triggers by changed paths - but this is tag-based release, not really applicable.

6. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT: Bound jobs with custom timeout - need representative history.

7. P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST: Run previously failing jobs first - ci_service scope, needs policy.

8. P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT: Derive timeout from history.

9. P-LIT-PRIORITIZE: Prioritize tests - build_configuration scope.

10. P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY: Prioritize queued builds.

11. P-LIT-SELECT: Select tests - contraindication: strict contract requires full test set.

12. P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT: Select builds - contraindication: required checks must run on each revision.

13. P-LIT-BAZEL-* - Bazel specific, not applicable (this uses cargo/rust).

14. P-LIT-ENV-CACHE: Reuse validated build environments - needs pinned dependencies.

15. P-LIT-UNAFFECTED-STEPS: Skip steps using traced dependencies.

16. P-LIT-SMELL-REPAIR: Repair configuration smells.

17. P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION: research only.

18. P-LIT-UNUSED-OUTPUTS: Remove unused outputs.

19. P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE: Share cached build dependencies - needs trusted cache infrastructure.

20. P-LIT-CONFIG-REUSE: Reuse work across compatible configurations.

21. P-LIT-UNUSED-DEP-SKIP: Skip unused-dependency updates.

The `release-pypi` job uses `actions/setup-python@v7` with `cache: pip` already. It runs `pipx run build`.

The `binary` job:
